passages.text: The scheme provides an annual scholarship to meritorious students from economically weaker families pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate courses.
The annual family income of the applicant shall not exceed Rs. 2,00,000 (Rupees Two Lakh only) from all sources.
The applicant must be currently enrolled in a recognised undergraduate or postgraduate programme.
The applicant must not be older than 25 years on 1 July of the academic year.

Applicants shall submit: (a) income certificate issued by the competent authority; (b) bonafide student certificate from the institution; (c) marksheet of the last qualifying examination; (d) caste certificate, only where the applicant claims a reserved-category relaxation.
A scholarship of Rs. 20,000 per academic year is payable to selected students.
Applications are accepted until 31 October of the academic year.

Applications are submitted online through the official portal notified for this scheme. The applicant registers, fills in the form, uploads the listed documents and submits before the deadline. The institution verifies the application before it is considered for selection.
The scheme provides an annual scholarship to meritorious students from economically weaker families pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate courses.
The annual family income of the applicant shall not exceed Rs. 3,00,000 (Rupees Three Lakh only) from all sources.
The applicant must be currently enrolled in a recognised undergraduate or postgraduate programme.
The applicant should not be older than 25 years as on 1 July of the academic year.

Applicants shall submit: (a) income certificate issued by the competent authority; (b) bonafide student certificate from the institution; (c) marksheet of the last qualifying examination; (d) caste certificate, only where the applicant claims a reserved-category relaxation.; (e) a bank account in the applicant's own name (account details are entered only on the official portal).
A scholarship of Rs. 25,000 per academic year is payable to selected students.
Applications are accepted until 15 November of the academic year.

Applications are submitted online through the official portal notified for this scheme. The applicant registers, fills in the form, uploads the listed documents and submits before the deadline. The institution verifies the application before it is considered for selection.
Income certificates are issued by the revenue authority of the applicant's state of residence. The applicant should apply through the office or portal specified by that state.
This revision takes effect from 1 July 2025 and supersedes the guidelines issued on 10 June 2024.

documents.title: Demo Small Farmer Input Support Guidelines

passages.text: The scheme provides input support to small and marginal farmers to reduce the cost of cultivation.
The beneficiary must be engaged in cultivation as the main occupation.
The total operational landholding of the beneficiary family shall not exceed 2 hectares.
The beneficiary must be at least 18 years of age.

The applicant shall provide: (a) land ownership record showing the landholding, where the applicant owns the land; (b) a bank account in the applicant's own name; (c) where the applicant cultivates land as a tenant, a registered tenancy agreement.
An input support grant of Rs. 6,000 per year is paid in instalments.
Applications are submitted at the nearest agriculture office or through the portal notified by the state agriculture department.

documents.title: Demo Women Entrepreneur Seed Support Guidelines

passages.text: The scheme offers one-time seed support to women who are starting or running a micro enterprise.
Only women applicants are eligible.
The applicant must be between 18 and 45 years of age (both inclusive).
The applicant must be a resident of Delhi or Maharashtra.
The applicant must be planning to start, or already running, a micro enterprise.

The applicant shall submit: (a) a business plan or enterprise description; (b) proof of residence in the state; (c) category certificate, where the applicant belongs to SC, ST or OBC and seeks the additional seed amount.
Seed support of up to Rs. 50,000 is provided; applicants from SC, ST or OBC categories may receive an additional Rs. 10,000.
Applications remain open until 28 February 2027.
Applications are accepted through the enterprise development office of the respective state.

The applicant must be 60 years of age or above.
The annual household income of the applicant shall not exceed Rs. 1,00,000.
A person already receiving another government old-age pension is not eligible under this scheme.
The applicant must have resided in the State continuously for not less than [illegible in scanned copy] years.
The applicant shall submit: (a) proof of age; (b) income certificate issued by the competent authority.
A monthly pension of Rs. 1,500 is payable.
Applications are made at the local social welfare office.
